items.source: NOTE: Exception handling in TaskDecorator implementations is limited to plain Runnable execution via execute calls. In case of #submit calls, the exposed Runnable will be a FutureTask which does not propagate any exceptions; you might have to cast it and call Future#get to evaluate exceptions.
items.translation: 注意：TaskDecorator 实现中的异常处理仅限于通过 execute 调用执行的普通 Runnable。对于 #submit 调用，暴露的 Runnable 将是一个 FutureTask，它不会传播任何异常；您可能需要将其转换为 Future 并调用 get 方法来评估异常。

items.source: The default is false, not tracking active threads at all or just interrupting any remaining threads that still have not finished after the specified taskTerminationTimeout. Switch this to true for immediate interruption on close, either in combination with a subsequent termination timeout or without any waiting at all, depending on whether a taskTerminationTimeout has been specified as well.
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`，即完全不跟踪活动线程，或者在指定的taskTerminationTimeout之后仅中断尚未完成的剩余线程。将此值切换为 `true` 以实现关闭时的立即中断，具体是结合后续的终止超时使用，还是完全不加等待，取决于是否同时指定了taskTerminationTimeout。

items.source: Supports a graceful shutdown through setTaskTerminationTimeout(long), at the expense of task tracking overhead per execution thread at runtime. Supports limiting concurrent threads through setConcurrencyLimit(int). By default, the number of concurrent task executions is unlimited.
items.translation: 支持通过setTaskTerminationTimeout(long)实现优雅关闭，但会牺牲运行时每个执行线程的任务跟踪开销。支持通过setConcurrencyLimit(int)限制并发线程数。默认情况下，并发任务执行次数没有限制。

items.source: NOTE: This implementation does not reuse threads! Consider a thread-pooling TaskExecutor implementation instead, in particular for executing a large number of short-lived tasks. Alternatively, on JDK 21, consider setting setVirtualThreads(boolean) to true.
items.translation: 注意：此实现不会复用线程！ 对于执行大量短生命周期任务的情况，请考虑使用线程池的 TaskExecutor 实现。或者，在 JDK 21 上，请考虑将setVirtualThreads(boolean)设置为true。

items.source: Note that SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor does not participate in a coordinated lifecycle stop but rather just awaits task termination on close().
items.translation: 注意，SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor 不参与协调的生命周期停止，而只是在close()处等待任务终止。

items.source: NOTE: This executor does not participate in context-level lifecycle management. Tasks on handed-off execution threads cannot be centrally stopped and restarted; if such tight lifecycle management is necessary, consider a common ThreadPoolTaskExecutor setup instead.
items.translation: 注意：此执行器不参与上下文级别的生命周期管理。 在移交的执行线程上运行的任务无法被集中停止和重启；如果确实需要如此紧密的生命周期管理，请考虑使用通用的 ThreadPoolTaskExecutor 配置。

items.source: The default is false, indicating platform threads. Set this flag to true in order to create virtual threads instead.
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`，表示平台线程。将此标志设置为 `true` 以创建虚拟线程。

items.source: The default is false, blocking the caller until the submission can be accepted. Switch this to true for immediate rejection instead.
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`，会阻塞调用者直到提交被接受。将其切换为 `true` 以立即拒绝。

items.source: As of 6.1, this method comes with a default implementation that delegates to TaskExecutor.execute(Runnable).
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，此方法具有默认实现，该实现委托给TaskExecutor.execute(Runnable)。

items.source: This is the equivalent of a maximum pool size in a thread pool, preventing temporary overload of the thread management system. However, in contrast to a thread pool with a managed task queue, this executor will block the submitter until the task can be accepted when the configured concurrency limit has been reached. If you prefer queue-based task hand-offs without such blocking, consider using a ThreadPoolTaskExecutor instead.
items.translation: 这是线程池中最大池大小的等效设置，可防止线程管理系统出现临时过载。然而，与具有托管任务队列的线程池相比，当达到配置的并发限制时，此执行器将阻塞提交者直到任务可以被接受。如果您更喜欢基于队列的任务交接且无需此类阻塞，请考虑使用 ThreadPoolTaskExecutor 替代。

items.source:
You may specify an inner ThreadFactory bean or also a ThreadFactory reference

items.translation: 您可以指定一个内部 `ThreadFactory` Bean，或者从 JNDI（在 Jakarta EE 服务器上）或其他查找机制获取的 `ThreadFactory` 引用。

items.source:
Note that a concrete >0 timeout specified here will lead to the
wrapping of every submitted task into a task-tracking runnable which
involves considerable overhead in case of a high number of tasks.
However, for a modest level of submissions with longer-running
tasks, this is feasible in order to arrive at a graceful shutdown.
items.translation: 请注意，在此处指定一个具体的 >0 超时时间会导致每个提交的任务都被包装成一个任务跟踪的可运行对象；在任务数量较多的情况下，这将产生相当大的开销。然而，对于提交量适中且任务运行时间较长的情况，这是可行的，以便实现优雅关闭。

items.source:
Executes urgent tasks (with 'immediate' timeout) directly,
bypassing the concurrency throttle (if active). All other
tasks are subject to throttling.
items.translation: 直接执行紧急任务（带有“立即”超时），绕过并发节流（如果已启用）。所有其他任务均受节流限制。

items.source: The default implementation creates a new Thread and starts it.
items.translation: 默认实现会创建一个新的线程并启动它。

items.source: This close method tracks the termination of active threads if a concrete task termination timeout has been set.
items.translation: 此关闭方法会在设置具体的任务终止超时时，跟踪活动线程的终止。

items.source: Specify whether to cancel remaining tasks on close: that is, whether to interrupt any active threads at the time of the close() call.
items.translation: 指定在关闭时是否取消剩余任务：即在调用close()时是否中断任何活动线程。

items.source: Specify whether to reject tasks when the concurrency limit has been reached, throwing TaskRejectedException on any further submission attempts.
items.translation: 指定在达到并发限制时是否拒绝任务，并在任何进一步的提交尝试中抛出TaskRejectedException。

items.source: This close method tracks the termination of active threads if a concrete task termination timeout has been set. Otherwise, it is not necessary to close this executor.
items.translation: 此关闭方法会在已设置具体的任务终止超时时，跟踪活跃线程的终止。否则，无需关闭此执行器。

items.source: Switch concurrency 'off': that is, don't allow any concurrent invocations.
items.translation: 切换并发为“关闭”：即不允许任何并发调用。

items.source: Permit any number of concurrent invocations: that is, don't throttle concurrency.
items.translation: 允许任意数量的并发调用：即不对并发进行节流。

items.source:
Return whether this executor is still active, i.e. not closed yet,
and therefore accepts further task submissions. Otherwise, it is
either in the task termination phase or entirely shut down already.

items.source: startTimeout - the time duration (milliseconds) within which the task is supposed to start. This is intended as a hint to the executor, allowing for preferred handling of immediate tasks. Typical values are AsyncTaskExecutor.TIMEOUT_IMMEDIATE or AsyncTaskExecutor.TIMEOUT_INDEFINITE (the default as used by TaskExecutor.execute(Runnable)).
items.translation: startTimeout - 任务预期开始的时间间隔（毫秒）。这旨在作为执行器的提示，以便优先处理即时任务。典型值为 AsyncTaskExecutor.TIMEOUT_IMMEDIATE 或 AsyncTaskExecutor.TIMEOUT_INDEFINITE（默认值，由 TaskExecutor.execute(Runnable) 使用）。
